tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Ink is the default page; Paper is the band for visual work and anything printed-feeling.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Window bodies, demo boxes and other framed areas that sit on ground.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and heavy frames on ground and panel (12:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and meta lines on ground and panel (5:1 or more in both themes). Never for running paragraphs.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between note blocks, dotted dividers, outlines of the big background words. Decorative only, never the only sign of a boundary that matters.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: 2px and 3px borders on windows, the masthead rule and boxed name. Same value as text, named for intent.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent: a hot, fully saturated red with no orange in it. Emphasised phrases, tag and band fills, hard offset shadows, placeholders, focus rings, label-maker tape. Text on ground and panel holds 4.5:1 in both themes. Use it in small quantities against large fields of ground.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (tags, running bands, label-maker tape), 5:1 or more in both themes. Never white.

tokens.name: second-ink
tokens.usage: Off-register ghost behind the largest headline and the hover fringe on artwork. Never text, never a fill larger than a stroke.

tokens.name: swatch-yellow
tokens.usage: Registration swatch strip only.

tokens.name: swatch-magenta
tokens.usage: Registration swatch strip only.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Glow and bloom around signal text and the block cursor inside screens, the rolling CRT band and screen burn-in. Decoration only, never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: Scanline stripes of the CRT overlay (1px line every 3px). Only on screen panels: terminals, windows, readouts. Never on page paragraphs.

tokens.name: trace-grid
tokens.usage: Grid behind the signal trace and the unlit cells of a meter. Decorative only.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Masking tape that holds windows and cards in place. Decoration only, never carries text.

tokens.name: redact
tokens.usage: Marker that blacks out an old label before a new one goes over it. Decoration only.

families.mono: "Cascadia Mono", "Cascadia Code", Consolas, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The lead project's name, once per page, uppercase. Scales down to 44px on phones (class pb-h1).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Further project names and the About name, uppercase. 30px on phones (class pb-h2).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: This tool lets someone turn a photo of a receipt into a spreadsheet row.
styles.usage: The one plain sentence under a project name that says what the thing lets someone do. Max 46ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I wrote the parser myself and used AI to draft the test cases.
styles.usage: All running text. 16px on phones. Max 62ch.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Ink drawing, scanned and cleaned up in Krita.
styles.usage: Image captions and input/result notes, in text-muted or text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase meta lines, nav links, window titles. Always text-muted on ground or text on panel.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Uppercase headings of the four project note blocks and tags.

groups.name: Terminal
groups.note: Cascadia Mono and Consolas ship with Windows, so there is no font file. Mono is for screen text only: terminal lines, readouts, file names in window bars.

styles.name: term
styles.usage: Lines inside a terminal panel. Commands start with the signal prompt; output lines are plain text.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Uppercase label and value pairs in readouts and terminal status lines. Values are real facts only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a label pair, swatch strip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to its value; gap between stacked caption lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; gap inside an input/result pair.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside note blocks; gap between a figure and its caption block.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between parts of one project (head, screenshot, notes, pair).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones; gap between artworks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop; gap between projects.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every corner. Nothing in this system is rounded.

shadow.note: Hard offsets only, no blur. They read as a second printed layer, not as elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Behind windows (screenshots, input/result). 5px on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-tag
tokens.usage: Behind section tags.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Behind stickers that overlap a window corner.

stroke.note: Border widths. Square ends, solid unless named otherwise.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules between note blocks; crop marks.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: Window borders, boxed name, dashed placeholder and demo boxes.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Masthead and footer rule; dotted section divider.

tokens.name: stroke-art
tokens.usage: Outer frame around an artwork, with a 1px outline 5px outside it.

tilt.note: Small rotations that make the page feel pasted up. Never on running text or screenshots.

tokens.name: tilt-tag
tokens.usage: Section tags.

tokens.name: tilt-sticker
tokens.usage: Stickers on a window corner.

tokens.name: tilt-band
tokens.usage: Signal running band.

tokens.name: tilt-band-alt
tokens.usage: Text-coloured running band, the opposite lean.
